Build Sprint 7 — Commissions engine. Working dir: `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/InkOS`.

**Inputs:**
- Design spec: `.handoffs/sprint-7-design-spec.md` (14-step build, `/commissions` hub with 5 tabs, role-gated UI, `CommissionPreview` component, Studio tier+ gate)
- Migration handoff: `.handoffs/sprint-7-dato-migration.md`
- Migration LIVE: `supabase/migrations/20260416000004_commissions.sql` (4 tables, 8 RPCs, auto-compute trigger on booking.status='completed', role-scoped RLS)
- Types updated
- Feature gating: `commissions.view` permission + Studio tier gate via Sprint 4 `UpgradeGate`

**Execute 14-step build sequence from design spec.**

**Key routes:**
- `app/(app)/commissions/page.tsx` — Dashboard (default) + 5-tab layout (URL subpath)
- `app/(app)/commissions/records/page.tsx`
- `app/(app)/commissions/rules/page.tsx`
- `app/(app)/commissions/adjustments/page.tsx`
- `app/(app)/commissions/disputes/page.tsx`
- Update: `app/(app)/appointments/[id]/page.tsx` — add Commission section
- Update: `app/(app)/artists/[id]/performance/page.tsx` — real commission data

**API routes (authed, session-derived studio, `authedRatelimit`, Zod):**
- `/api/commissions/records` — GET list with filters, role-scoped
- `/api/commissions/records/[id]` — GET detail
- `/api/commissions/records/approve` — POST bulk (calls `approve_commissions` RPC)
- `/api/commissions/records/[id]/cancel` — POST (calls `cancel_commission` RPC)
- `/api/commissions/records/[id]/recalculate` — POST (calls `recalculate_commission` RPC)
- `/api/commissions/records/[id]/dispute` — POST (calls `raise_commission_dispute` RPC)
- `/api/commissions/rules` — GET list, POST create
- `/api/commissions/rules/[id]` — GET, PATCH, DELETE (soft via effective_until)
- `/api/commissions/adjustments` — GET, POST (calls `create_adjustment` RPC)
- `/api/commissions/adjustments/[id]` — GET, PATCH status
- `/api/commissions/disputes` — GET list
- `/api/commissions/disputes/[id]/resolve` — POST (calls `resolve_dispute` RPC)
- `/api/commissions/dashboard` — GET (calls `get_studio_commission_dashboard` RPC)
- `/api/commissions/artists/[artistId]/summary` — GET (calls `get_artist_commission_summary` RPC)
- `/api/bookings/[id]/commission` — GET (fetch commission record for booking)

**All routes enforce feature gate:** `requireFeature(studioId, 'commission_splits')` (Studio tier+). Return 403 with `{requiredPlan: 'studio'}` if not.

**Components (per spec inventory):**
- `components/commissions/CommissionsHub.tsx` (5-tab shell)
- `components/commissions/CommissionsDashboard.tsx`
- `components/commissions/TopEarnersLeaderboard.tsx`
- `components/commissions/RecordsTable.tsx`
- `components/commissions/RecordDetailDrawer.tsx`
- `components/commissions/BulkApprovalFooter.tsx`
- `components/commissions/RulesList.tsx`
- `components/commissions/RuleTimelineBar.tsx`
- `components/commissions/RuleEditorDrawer.tsx`
- `components/commissions/AdjustmentsList.tsx`
- `components/commissions/AdjustmentModal.tsx`
- `components/commissions/DisputesList.tsx`
- `components/commissions/RaiseDisputeModal.tsx`
- `components/commissions/DisputeResolutionDrawer.tsx`
- `components/commissions/CommissionPreview.tsx` (reusable)
- `components/commissions/CalculationBreakdown.tsx`
- `components/commissions/CommissionStatusBadge.tsx`
- `components/commissions/StatusTimeline.tsx`
- `components/commissions/CommissionPerformanceCard.tsx` (for artist profile)
- `components/commissions/AppointmentCommissionSection.tsx` (for appointment detail)
- `components/billing/UpgradeGate.tsx` — reuse inline variant
- `lib/commissions/calculate-preview.ts` — pure `calculateCommission(price, tip, rule)` function

**Role-scoped UI:**
- If role='artist', hide approve/cancel/recalculate actions, hide dashboard leaderboard (show own summary), hide bulk actions, make rules tab read-only
- RLS also enforces at DB level — UI just mirrors for UX
- Use `usePermissions()` hook from Sprint 6

**Integration touchpoints:**
- Sprint 2 booking create drawer: add `CommissionPreview` showing calc preview when artist + service selected
- Sprint 2 appointment detail: Commission section with rule applied + status + inline approve (owner/admin only)
- Sprint 6 artist Performance tab: real commission summary card

**Hard rules:**
- Zero `any`, zero `console.log` (use `lib/logger.ts`), zero raw hex outside brand
- `@supabase/ssr` only, `getUser()` never `getSession()`
- Never trust client-sent `studio_id`
- Money in cents, display via `formatCurrency`
- base-nova `render` not `asChild`
- CSS `group-data-[collapsible=icon]:*` sidebar
- `animationFillMode: "both"` on staggered lists
- Every mutation → Sonner toast
- Feature gate server-enforced on every API route (Studio+ tier)
- Role gating via `usePermissions()` for UI, RLS for DB
- `commission_records.total_cents` is GENERATED — never in INSERT/UPDATE

**Pattern references:**
- `~/.claude/memory/patterns/good/ui-ux-production-standards.md`
- `~/.claude/memory/patterns/good/saas-winning-patterns.md`
- `~/.claude/memory/patterns/good/billing-patterns.md`
- `~/.claude/memory/patterns/good/executable-validation-gates.md`

**Stubs deferred:**
- Commission charts (Sprint 12)
- Auto-email artist on approval (Sprint 11 marketing automation — basic `logger.info` placeholder)
- Payroll linkage (Sprint 8)

**Validation — all 4 gates:**
```bash
pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm build && pnpm test
```

**Deliverables:**
1. All 4 gates green
2. `.handoffs/sprint-7-build-report.md` with file inventory, deviations, stubs, acceptance criteria
3. Short summary: file counts, blockers

Do NOT touch Sprint 8+ scope (payroll, 1099-K). Preserve all prior sprint work.

1	# Sprint 7 — Dato Handoff: Commissions Engine
2	
3	Migration file: `supabase/migrations/20260416000004_commissions.sql`
4	
5	---
6	
7	## Table Inventory
8	
9	| Table | Ownership | RLS Scope | Realtime |
10	|---|---|---|---|
11	| `commission_rules` | studio_id | SELECT: all members; INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE: owner/admin | No |
12	| `commission_records` | studio_id | SELECT: admin sees all, artist sees own; direct write blocked | No |
13	| `commission_adjustments` | studio_id | SELECT: admin sees all, artist sees own; INSERT/UPDATE: admin; DELETE: blocked | No |
14	| `commission_disputes` | studio_id | SELECT: admin or raised_by; direct write blocked | No |
15	
16	---
17	
18	## commission_rules
19	
20	Stores per-artist, optionally per-service commission rules.
21	
22	Key columns:
23	- `percentage numeric(5,2)` — nullable; artist % of `service_price_cents`
24	- `flat_fee_cents int` — nullable; fixed addition to commission
25	- `tip_split_pct numeric(5,2) DEFAULT 100` — % of tip that goes to artist (100 = artist keeps all tip)
26	- `priority int DEFAULT 0` — higher wins when multiple rules match
27	- `effective_from date DEFAULT CURRENT_DATE`
28	- `effective_until date` — NULL = indefinitely active
29	- CHECK: `percentage IS NOT NULL OR flat_fee_cents IS NOT NULL` — at least one must be set
30	- `created_by uuid REFERENCES profiles(id)` — who created the rule
31	
32	Rule matching: service-specific rule beats catch-all (service_id IS NULL), then priority DESC, then effective_from DESC.
33	
34	---
35	
36	## commission_records
37	
38	One record per completed booking. Created by trigger only.
39	
40	Key columns:
41	- `booking_id uuid UNIQUE NOT NULL` — one commission record per booking, enforced
42	- `rule_id uuid` — nullable; SET NULL on rule delete; snapshot preserves data
43	- `rule_snapshot jsonb NOT NULL` — frozen rule at calculation time (see schema below)
44	- `service_price_cents int NOT NULL` — snapshot of `booking.price_cents` at completion
45	- `commission_cents int NOT NULL` — computed service commission
46	- `tip_commission_cents int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0` — computed tip commission
47	- `total_cents int GENERATED ALWAYS AS (commission_cents + tip_commission_cents) STORED` — **never supply in INSERT or UPDATE**
48	- `status text` — `pending | approved | paid | cancelled | disputed`
49	- `payroll_run_id uuid` — logical FK only; Sprint 8 adds physical constraint
50	
51	### rule_snapshot JSON structure
52	
53	```json
54	{
55	  "rule_id": "uuid or null",
56	  "percentage": 50.00,
57	  "flat_fee_cents": null,
58	  "tip_split_pct": 100.00,
59	  "priority": 0,
60	  "effective_from": "2026-04-16",
61	  "matched_by": "service_specific | catch_all | artist_default | none"
62	}
63	```
64	
65	When `recalculate_commission` is called, `recalculated_at` is added to the snapshot.
66	
67	---
68	
69	## commission_adjustments
70	
71	Manual entries for bonuses, penalties, corrections, guest splits.
72	
73	Key columns:
74	- `amount_cents int NOT NULL` — signed: positive = add to artist; negative = deduct
75	- `kind text` — `bonus | penalty | correction | guest_split | other`
76	- `payroll_run_id uuid` — logical FK only; Sprint 8 enforces
77	- `status text DEFAULT 'approved'` — `pending | approved | cancelled`
78	
79	The cancellation trigger inserts a `penalty` adjustment (with `status='pending'`) when a booking is cancelled after its commission was already `approved` or `paid`. This ensures the financial trail is auditable and requires explicit owner review.
80	
81	---
82	
83	## commission_disputes
84	
85	Formal dispute lifecycle.
86	
87	Key columns:
88	- `commission_record_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES commission_records(id) ON DELETE CASCADE`
89	- `raised_by uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES profiles(id)` — the disputing party
90	- `status text DEFAULT 'open'` — `open | resolved | dismissed`
91	- `resolved_at timestamptz` — set by `resolve_dispute` RPC
92	
93	---
94	
95	## Trigger Logic
96	
97	### `on_booking_completed_commission` (AFTER UPDATE on bookings)
98	
99	Fires only when `NEW.status = 'completed'` AND `OLD.status != 'completed'`.
100	
101	Rule-match algorithm:
102	1. Query `commission_rules` where `artist_id = booking.artist_id` AND (`service_id = booking.service_id` OR `service_id IS NULL`) AND date range active.
103	2. Sort: `service_id IS NOT NULL DESC, priority DESC, effective_from DESC`. Take first row.
104	3. If rule has both `percentage` + `flat_fee_cents`: commission = `round(price * pct/100) + flat_fee`.
105	4. If only `percentage`: commission = `round(price * pct/100)`.
106	5. If only `flat_fee_cents`: commission = `flat_fee_cents`.
107	6. `tip_commission_cents = round(tip_cents * tip_split_pct / 100)`.
108	7. Fallback (no rule): use `artists.commission_default_pct` with 100% tip split. `calculation_notes = 'no_rule_matched:used_artist_default_pct'`.
109	8. Fallback (no default): commission = 0, tip_commission = 0. `calculation_notes = 'no_rule_matched:no_default:commission_zero'`.
110	9. `INSERT … ON CONFLICT (booking_id) DO NOTHING` — safe to re-trigger.
111	
112	### `on_booking_cancelled_commission` (AFTER UPDATE on bookings)
113	
114	Fires when `NEW.status IN ('cancelled', 'no_show')` AND `OLD.status NOT IN ('cancelled', 'no_show')`.
115	
116	- `commission_record.status = 'pending'` → set to `cancelled`.
117	- `commission_record.status = 'approved' | 'paid'` → insert `commission_adjustment` with `kind='penalty'`, `amount_cents = -(total_cents)`, `status='pending'`. Requires manual owner review.
118	- No commission record (booking never completed) → no-op.
119	
120	### `audit_commission_records_status` (AFTER UPDATE on commission_records)
121	
122	Fires when `status` field changes. Inserts row into `audit_log` with old/new status, booking_id, artist_id, total_cents.
123	
124	---
125	
126	## RPC Contracts
127	
128	All RPCs are `SECURITY DEFINER`, `VOLATILE` (or `STABLE` for reads), `SET search_path = public`.
129	
130	| RPC | Caller | Returns | Notes |
131	|---|---|---|---|
132	| `approve_commissions(p_record_ids uuid[])` | owner/admin | `int` (approved count) | Skips records from studios the caller doesn't admin; logs each approval |
133	| `cancel_commission(p_record_id, p_reason)` | **owner only** (not admin) | `jsonb {ok, id}` | Blocked if status is `cancelled` or `paid` |
134	| `recalculate_commission(p_record_id)` | owner/admin | `jsonb {ok, commission_cents, tip_commission_cents, total_cents, matched_by}` | Only for `status='pending'`; re-runs full rule match |
135	| `create_adjustment(p_artist_id, p_amount_cents, p_kind, p_reason)` | owner/admin | `uuid` (new adjustment id) | Auto-approved; negative amount = deduction |
136	| `get_artist_commission_summary(p_artist_id, p_from, p_to)` | own artist or owner/admin | `jsonb` | Returns pending/approved/paid/cancelled/disputed totals, adjustment total, net_owed, by_month array |
137	| `get_studio_commission_dashboard(p_studio_id, p_from, p_to)` | owner/admin | `jsonb` | Per-artist rows + studio totals; each row includes adjustment_cents |
138	| `raise_commission_dispute(p_record_id, p_reason)` | own artist or owner/admin | `uuid` (dispute id) | Sets commission_record.status='disputed'; creates commission_disputes row |
139	| `resolve_dispute(p_dispute_id, p_resolution_notes, p_outcome)` | owner/admin | `boolean` | `p_outcome='upheld'` resets record to 'pending'; `'dismissed'` restores to 'approved' |
140	
141	---
142	
143	## Role-Scoped RLS Pattern
144	
145	`commission_records` and `commission_adjustments` use a split SELECT policy:
146	
147	```sql
148	USING (
149	  studio_id = ANY(public.user_studio_ids())
150	  AND (
151	    public.user_is_studio_admin(studio_id)
152	    OR artist_id IN (
153	      SELECT id FROM public.artists WHERE profile_id = auth.uid()
154	    )
155	  )
156	)
157	```
158	
159	Owners/admins see all records in their studio. Artists see only records where they are the artist. Receptionists and guest artists have no visibility into commission data.
160	
161	Direct INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE on `commission_records` and `commission_disputes` is blocked via `WITH CHECK (false)` / `USING (false)` policies. All mutations go through SECURITY DEFINER RPCs.
162	
163	---
164	
165	## Sprint 8 Forward References
166	
167	Two columns reference a `payroll_runs` table that does not exist yet:
168	
169	- `commission_records.payroll_run_id uuid` — logical FK
170	- `commission_adjustments.payroll_run_id uuid` — logical FK
171	
172	Sprint 8 must run:
173	
174	```sql
175	ALTER TABLE public.commission_records
176	  ADD CONSTRAINT commission_records_payroll_run_id_fkey
177	  FOREIGN KEY (payroll_run_id) REFERENCES public.payroll_runs(id) ON DELETE SET NULL;
178	
179	ALTER TABLE public.commission_adjustments
180	  ADD CONSTRAINT commission_adjustments_payroll_run_id_fkey
181	  FOREIGN KEY (payroll_run_id) REFERENCES public.payroll_runs(id) ON DELETE SET NULL;
182	```
183	
184	The indexes (`idx_commission_records_payroll_run_id`, `idx_commission_adjustments_payroll_run_id`) are already created in Sprint 7 and will be used immediately once Sprint 8 enforces the FK.
185	
186	---
187	
188	## Gotchas for Koda
189	
190	1. **`total_cents` is GENERATED** — never include in Insert or Update. Read from Row type only.
191	2. **`commission_records` INSERT is blocked by RLS** — the `insert_denied` policy with `WITH CHECK (false)` means any direct `.insert()` call from the client will error. Only the trigger (SECURITY DEFINER) writes commission records.
192	3. **Same for `commission_disputes`** — use `raise_commission_dispute` RPC; never `.insert()` directly.
193	4. **`booking_id` is UNIQUE** — duplicate completions (re-triggering status update) are silently ignored via `ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING`.
194	5. **Artist visibility is scoped** — an artist calling `get_artist_commission_summary` for another artist's ID will get `{error: 'forbidden'}`, not empty data.
195	6. **Cancellation of approved/paid commission** — creates a `penalty` adjustment in `status='pending'`, not a direct reversal. Owner must review and approve the penalty before it counts against the artist.
196	7. **`payroll_run_id` is nullable and unvalidated** until Sprint 8. Don't rely on FK integrity for payroll grouping yet.
197	8. **`recalculate_commission` re-snapshots booking.price_cents** — if the booking price was edited after completion, recalculation uses the new price. This is intentional.
198	9. **`get_studio_commission_dashboard` is `STABLE` not `VOLATILE`** — safe to cache in Next.js `unstable_cache` with a short TTL (e.g., 60 seconds).
199	
200	---
201	
202	## TypeScript Types (lib/supabase/types.ts)
203	
204	```typescript
205	import type { Database } from '@/lib/supabase/types'
206	import type { CommissionRuleSnapshot, CommissionStatus, CommissionAdjustmentKind } from '@/lib/supabase/types'
207	
208	type CommissionRule = Database['public']['Tables']['commission_rules']['Row']
209	type CommissionRecord = Database['public']['Tables']['commission_records']['Row']
210	type CommissionAdjustment = Database['public']['Tables']['commission_adjustments']['Row']
211	type CommissionDispute = Database['public']['Tables']['commission_disputes']['Row']
212	```
213	
214	Named exports also available: `CommissionRule`, `CommissionRecord`, `CommissionAdjustment`, `CommissionDispute`, `CommissionStatus`, `CommissionAdjustmentKind`, `CommissionDisputeStatus`, `CommissionRuleSnapshot`.
215

1	# InkOS — Project Context for Claude Code
2	
3	**Stack:** A (Next.js 16.2.3 + Supabase + Railway + Dodo Payments)
4	**Status:** Sprint 0 complete — scaffold ready
5	**Scaffolded by:** Riko on 2026-04-15
6	**Build plan:** `~/.claude/plans/immutable-conjuring-pelican.md` (12 sprints, 24 weeks)
7	
8	---
9	
10	## What InkOS Is
11	
12	Multi-tenant tattoo studio management SaaS. Authenticated web app only (no marketing pages in v1). 4-tier pricing (Solo $29 / Studio $59 / Pro $99 / Enterprise $199). Multi-user from day 1 (owners + artists + receptionists). 12-sprint build targeting first paying studios at 24 weeks.
13	
14	---
15	
16	## Forbidden (Sage hard-fails)
17	
18	- `@supabase/auth-helpers-nextjs` — use `@supabase/ssr`
19	- Vercel — use Railway
20	- Stripe — use Dodo Payments
21	- NextAuth — use Supabase Auth
22	- Prisma or any ORM — use Supabase client + generated types
23	- Pages Router — App Router only
24	- npm / yarn — pnpm only
25	- CSS modules — Tailwind only
26	- `any` TypeScript type — zero exceptions
27	- `console.log` — use `lib/logger.ts` (pino)
28	- Raw hex colors except `--color-ink-black` and `--color-electric-purple` in `globals.css`
29	- `tailwind.config.ts` — Tailwind 4 uses `@theme inline` in `globals.css` only
30	- Default Tailwind shadows (`shadow-sm`, `shadow-md`) — use `shadow-soft`, `shadow-card`, `shadow-soft-md`
31	
32	---
33	
34	## Key Architecture Decisions
35	
36	1. **Next.js 16 uses `proxy.ts` not `middleware.ts`** — the file is at the project root, not in `app/`
37	2. **`instrumentation-client.ts` is REQUIRED** — missing this = no browser errors in Sentry
38	3. **`cookies()` is async in Next.js 16** — always `await cookies()`
39	4. **Worker packages must NEVER import `next/*`** — separate `package.json` in `workers/`
40	5. **BullMQ ioredis requires `maxRetriesPerRequest: null`** — silent failure without it
41	6. **Supabase service-role client bypasses RLS** — only use in webhook handlers + admin ops
42	7. **Webhook handler uses `timingSafeEqual`** — constant-time HMAC comparison, never `===`
43	8. **Subscriptions table is write-only by webhook** — no app code writes to it directly
44	9. **Tailwind 4 — no `tailwind.config.ts`** — all tokens in `app/globals.css` `@theme inline`
45	
46	---
47	
48	## Folder Structure (top-level)
49	
50	```
51	app/
52	  (auth)/          login, signup, forgot-password, reset-password, callback, onboarding
53	  (app)/           all authenticated pages — sidebar wrapper
54	  admin/           admin panel (Sprint 12)
55	  api/
56	    health/        Railway healthcheck
57	    webhooks/dodo/ Dodo Payments webhook
58	  book/[studioSlug]/ PUBLIC client-facing booking (Sprint 2)
59	  globals.css      Tailwind 4 @theme inline — Vega owns tokens
60	  layout.tsx       Root: ThemeProvider + Toaster + fonts
61	
62	lib/
63	  env.ts           Zod boot-time validation
64	  supabase/        client.ts, server.ts, middleware.ts, types.ts
65	  dodo/            client.ts (Dodo Payments SDK)
66	  rate-limit.ts    Upstash: apiRatelimit, authedRatelimit, expensiveRatelimit
67	  cache.ts         Upstash Redis get/set/bust
68	  queue.ts         BullMQ enqueuer (web never processes jobs)
69	  logger.ts        pino structured logger
70	  audit.ts         logAuditAction() helper
71	  utils.ts         cn(), formatCurrency(), slugify()
72	
73	proxy.ts           Next.js 16 session middleware (was middleware.ts in 15)
74	instrumentation.ts Sentry server init
75	instrumentation-client.ts Sentry browser init (REQUIRED)
76	
77	workers/
78	  jobs/            BullMQ worker service (separate Railway service)
79	  cron/            node-cron scheduler (separate Railway service)
80	
81	supabase/
82	  migrations/      SQL migrations — Dato owns
83	  config.toml      Supabase CLI config with branching enabled
84	```
85	
86	---
87	
88	## Active Sprint: Sprint 0 (complete)
89	
90	Sprint 0 deliverables:
91	- Full project scaffold (this)
92	- Migration #0001 (bootstrap.sql): profiles, studios, studio_members, locations, subscriptions, audit_log, webhook_events, RLS on all, auth.user_studio_ids(), handle_new_user()
93	- Lib: env, supabase, dodo client, rate-limit, cache, queue, logger, audit
94	- App shell: root layout, auth layout, app layout (auth check), dashboard stub
95	- API: health check, Dodo webhook with timingSafeEqual + Zod + idempotency
96	- Workers: jobs + cron scaffolds with graceful SIGTERM shutdown
97	- CI: GitHub Actions (typecheck + lint + test + build)
98	
99	## Next Sprint: Sprint 1 (Auth, Onboarding & App Shell)
100	
101	Koda builds in Sprint 1:
102	- `app/(auth)/login/page.tsx` — full LoginForm with Supabase email + Google OAuth
103	- `app/(auth)/signup/page.tsx` — SignupForm
104	- `app/(auth)/onboarding/page.tsx` — 5-step wizard (studio → location → artist → service → publish)
105	- `app/(app)/layout.tsx` — full SidebarProvider + AppSidebar + SidebarInset + AppHeader
106	- `app/(app)/dashboard/page.tsx` — 6 KPI cards wired to Supabase
107	- Migration: no new tables needed for Sprint 1
108	- Install shadcn sidebar: `pnpm dlx shadcn@latest add sidebar`
109	
110	---
111	
112	## Running Locally
113	
114	```bash
115	# Install
116	pnpm install
117	
118	# Copy env
119	cp .env.example .env.local
120	# Fill in NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL, NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY (get from Supabase project)
121	
122	# Start Supabase locally (optional — can use cloud project)
123	pnpm dlx supabase start
124	pnpm db:migrate
125	
126	# Dev server
127	pnpm dev
128	# http://localhost:3000 → redirects to /login
129	
130	# Verify
131	pnpm typecheck
132	pnpm build
133	```
134	
135	---
136	
137	## External Services Needed Before Sprint 1
138	
139	1. **Supabase project** — get URL + anon key + service role key
140	2. **Upstash Redis** — for rate limiting (free tier fine for dev)
141	3. **Dodo Payments** — can defer to Sprint 4, just needs a test account
142	4. **Resend** — can defer to Sprint 1 when sending invite emails
143	5. **Sentry** — can defer to Sprint 1, scaffold stubs exist
144	
145	---
146	
147	## Agent Routing
148	
149	- New feature code → **Koda**

10	## What InkOS Is
11

15

17	
18	- `@supabase/auth-helpers-nextjs` — use `@supabase/ssr`
19	- Vercel — use Railway
20	- Stripe — use Dodo Payments
21	- NextAuth — use Supabase Auth
22	- Prisma or any ORM — use Supabase client + generated types
23	- Pages Router — App Router only
24	- npm / yarn — pnpm only

35

41	6. **Supabase service-role client bypasses RLS** — only use in webhook handlers + admin ops
42	7. **Webhook handler uses `timingSafeEqual`** — constant-time HMAC comparison, never `===`
43	8. **Subscriptions table is write-only by webhook** — no app code writes to it directly
44	9. **Tailwind 4 — no `tailwind.config.ts`** — all tokens in `app/globals.css` `@theme inline`

This session is being continued from a previous conversation that ran out of context. The summary below covers the earlier portion of the conversation.

Summary:
1. Primary Request and Intent:
   Execute Build Sprint 7 — Commissions Engine for InkOS. Working directory: `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/InkOS`. The full build sequence requires CSS design tokens, pure calculation utility, 15 API routes, 21 React components, 5 page routes, 2 page updates, and all 4 validation gates must pass. The user confirmed migration `20260416000004_commissions.sql` is live. The session continues from a previous context where 10 components and all 15 API routes were already built.

2. Key Technical Concepts:
   - **Stack A**: Next.js 16.2.3 (App Router), React 19, TypeScript strict, Tailwind 4, shadcn/ui, Supabase (`@supabase/ssr` only)
   - **`total_cents` is GENERATED column** — never in INSERT/UPDATE payloads
   - **RLS block**: Direct INSERT on `commission_records` and `commission_disputes` blocked — use RPCs only
   - **Feature gate**: `requireFeature(plan, 'commissions')` returns 403 for Solo tier
   - **Role-scoped UI**: `canApprove`, `canManage`, `isOwner`, `isArtist` props control visibility; RLS enforces at DB level
   - **Tailwind 4**: `@theme inline` block in `globals.css` only — no `tailwind.config.ts`
   - **`cancel_commission` is owner-only** (not admin) — enforced in UI with `isOwner` check
   - **Rule editing pattern**: set `effective_until = today - 1` on old rule + INSERT new — handled by PATCH on `/api/commissions/rules/[id]`
   - **CSS class naming**: underscore variants used (`pill-rule-service_specific`) to match DB `matched_by` values directly
   - **No slider component** present in `components/ui/` — native `<input type="range">` used with inline CSS gradient
   - **`animationFillMode: 'both'`** required on staggered list animations
   - **Sonner toasts** on every mutation with specific messages per action
   - **`unstable_cache`** wrapping the two STABLE RPCs: `get_studio_commission_dashboard` (60s TTL) and `get_artist_commission_summary` (30s TTL)

3. Files and Code Sections:

   **Previously created (prior session):**

   **Created in this session:**

   - `components/commissions/RulesList.tsx`
     - Rules grouped by artist, each group in `<Card className="shadow-soft">` with `<CardHeader>` showing avatar + name + "Artist" chip
     - Each rule row: scope pill (`.pill-rule-{matched_by}`), description via `describeRule()`, effective dates, `RuleTimelineBar`, right-side Edit/DropdownMenu (owner/admin only)

     - Form: Artist Select, Kind RadioGroup (5 options: bonus/penalty/correction/guest_split/other), Amount with sign-toggle button (+ green / − red), Reason Textarea (max 500), Applied date

1	# InkOS — Project Context for Claude Code
2	
3	**Stack:** A (Next.js 16.2.3 + Supabase + Railway + Dodo Payments)
4	**Status:** Sprint 0 complete — scaffold ready
5	**Scaffolded by:** Riko on 2026-04-15
6	**Build plan:** `~/.claude/plans/immutable-conjuring-pelican.md` (12 sprints, 24 weeks)
7	
8	---
9	
10	## What InkOS Is
11	
12	Multi-tenant tattoo studio management SaaS. Authenticated web app only (no marketing pages in v1). 4-tier pricing (Solo $29 / Studio $59 / Pro $99 / Enterprise $199). Multi-user from day 1 (owners + artists + receptionists). 12-sprint build targeting first paying studios at 24 weeks.
13	
14	---
15	
16	## Forbidden (Sage hard-fails)
17	
18	- `@supabase/auth-helpers-nextjs` — use `@supabase/ssr`
19	- Vercel — use Railway
20	- Stripe — use Dodo Payments
21	- NextAuth — use Supabase Auth
22	- Prisma or any ORM — use Supabase client + generated types
23	- Pages Router — App Router only
24	- npm / yarn — pnpm only
25	- CSS modules — Tailwind only
26	- `any` TypeScript type — zero exceptions
27	- `console.log` — use `lib/logger.ts` (pino)
28	- Raw hex colors except `--color-ink-black` and `--color-electric-purple` in `globals.css`
29	- `tailwind.config.ts` — Tailwind 4 uses `@theme inline` in `globals.css` only
30	- Default Tailwind shadows (`shadow-sm`, `shadow-md`) — use `shadow-soft`, `shadow-card`, `shadow-soft-md`
31	
32	---
33	
34	## Key Architecture Decisions
35	
36	1. **Next.js 16 uses `proxy.ts` not `middleware.ts`** — the file is at the project root, not in `app/`
37	2. **`instrumentation-client.ts` is REQUIRED** — missing this = no browser errors in Sentry
38	3. **`cookies()` is async in Next.js 16** — always `await cookies()`
39	4. **Worker packages must NEVER import `next/*`** — separate `package.json` in `workers/`
40	5. **BullMQ ioredis requires `maxRetriesPerRequest: null`** — silent failure without it
41	6. **Supabase service-role client bypasses RLS** — only use in webhook handlers + admin ops
42	7. **Webhook handler uses `timingSafeEqual`** — constant-time HMAC comparison, never `===`
43	8. **Subscriptions table is write-only by webhook** — no app code writes to it directly
44	9. **Tailwind 4 — no `tailwind.config.ts`** — all tokens in `app/globals.css` `@theme inline`
45	
46	---
47	
48	## Folder Structure (top-level)
49	
50	```
51	app/
52	  (auth)/          login, signup, forgot-password, reset-password, callback, onboarding
53	  (app)/           all authenticated pages — sidebar wrapper
54	  admin/           admin panel (Sprint 12)
55	  api/
56	    health/        Railway healthcheck
57	    webhooks/dodo/ Dodo Payments webhook
58	  book/[studioSlug]/ PUBLIC client-facing booking (Sprint 2)
59	  globals.css      Tailwind 4 @theme inline — Vega owns tokens
60	  layout.tsx       Root: ThemeProvider + Toaster + fonts
61	
62	lib/
63	  env.ts           Zod boot-time validation
64	  supabase/        client.ts, server.ts, middleware.ts, types.ts
65	  dodo/            client.ts (Dodo Payments SDK)
66	  rate-limit.ts    Upstash: apiRatelimit, authedRatelimit, expensiveRatelimit
67	  cache.ts         Upstash Redis get/set/bust
68	  queue.ts         BullMQ enqueuer (web never processes jobs)
69	  logger.ts        pino structured logger
70	  audit.ts         logAuditAction() helper
71	  utils.ts         cn(), formatCurrency(), slugify()
72	
73	proxy.ts           Next.js 16 session middleware (was middleware.ts in 15)
74	instrumentation.ts Sentry server init
75	instrumentation-client.ts Sentry browser init (REQUIRED)
76	
77	workers/
78	  jobs/            BullMQ worker service (separate Railway service)
79	  cron/            node-cron scheduler (separate Railway service)
80	
81	supabase/
82	  migrations/      SQL migrations — Dato owns
83	  config.toml      Supabase CLI config with branching enabled
84	```
85	
86	---
87	
88	## Active Sprint: Sprint 0 (complete)
89	
90	Sprint 0 deliverables:
91	- Full project scaffold (this)
92	- Migration #0001 (bootstrap.sql): profiles, studios, studio_members, locations, subscriptions, audit_log, webhook_events, RLS on all, auth.user_studio_ids(), handle_new_user()
93	- Lib: env, supabase, dodo client, rate-limit, cache, queue, logger, audit
94	- App shell: root layout, auth layout, app layout (auth check), dashboard stub
95	- API: health check, Dodo webhook with timingSafeEqual + Zod + idempotency
96	- Workers: jobs + cron scaffolds with graceful SIGTERM shutdown
97	- CI: GitHub Actions (typecheck + lint + test + build)
98	
99	## Next Sprint: Sprint 1 (Auth, Onboarding & App Shell)
100	
101	Koda builds in Sprint 1:
102	- `app/(auth)/login/page.tsx` — full LoginForm with Supabase email + Google OAuth
103	- `app/(auth)/signup/page.tsx` — SignupForm
104	- `app/(auth)/onboarding/page.tsx` — 5-step wizard (studio → location → artist → service → publish)
105	- `app/(app)/layout.tsx` — full SidebarProvider + AppSidebar + SidebarInset + AppHeader
106	- `app/(app)/dashboard/page.tsx` — 6 KPI cards wired to Supabase
107	- Migration: no new tables needed for Sprint 1
108	- Install shadcn sidebar: `pnpm dlx shadcn@latest add sidebar`
109	
110	---
111	
112	## Running Locally
113	
114	```bash
115	# Install
116	pnpm install
117	
118	# Copy env
119	cp .env.example .env.local
120	# Fill in NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL, NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY (get from Supabase project)
121	
122	# Start Supabase locally (optional — can use cloud project)
123	pnpm dlx supabase start
124	pnpm db:migrate
125	
126	# Dev server
127	pnpm dev
128	# http://localhost:3000 → redirects to /login
129	
130	# Verify
131	pnpm typecheck
132	pnpm build
133	```
134	
135	---

137	## External Services Needed Before Sprint 1

141	3. **Dodo Payments** — can defer to Sprint 4, just needs a test account
142	4. **Resend** — can defer to Sprint 1 when sending invite emails
143	5. **Sentry** — can defer to Sprint 1, scaffold stubs exist

151	- Testing → **Luna**

Actually, `import type { hasFeature }` imports the type of the exported `hasFeature` value — and then `typeof hasFeature` in `Parameters<typeof hasFeature>[0]` will resolve correctly because TypeScript resolves the type from the type import. This is correct.
